lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples the poor are blessed, and so are those hated because of the Son of David.
Jesus pronounces woe on the rich, the well fed, and those who laugh now.
Jesus says to love your enemies, bless those who curse you, and turn the other cheek when struck.
Jesus says to love your enemies and lend expecting nothing, and you will be sons of Abraham.
Jesus says to be merciful, not judge, forgive, and give, because the measure you use will be measured back.
